the monetary system is a complex social system that requires the coordination of multiple institutions and actors, and the government is one of the most important institutions for that coordination.

the state is a key actor in the institutional evolution of the monetary system, as a regulator of financial innovation, as a guarantor of the efficiency of money, and as a provider of a public infrastructure for the development of the financial sector.
